caption: The drawing depicts a banjo-style wall clock set against a plain, light beige background. The clock features a round white face with Roman numerals marking the hours and two black hands indicating the time. At the top of the clock is a three-dimensional eagle figure, colored brown with its wings partially spread. The clock case is vertically elongated and predominantly white with gold, green, and red accents. The midsection of the case has a thermometer or decorative element encased in glass, flanked by gold decorations and green scrollwork below. The base of the clock is rectangular, bordered in blue and gold, and displays a painted scene with two sailing ships at sea, each flying flags, and an oval frame or medallion between them. The overall composition is vertically oriented and symmetrically arranged, with detailed and realistic color application giving a sense of depth and material texture to the clock and its decorations.
title: Banjo Clock
